prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that implements a PKCE login flow for public clients using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 2 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 3 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 4 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Option 5 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 6 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import os
import secrets
import hashlib
import base64
import urllib.parse
from typing import Dict, Optional, Tuple
import requests

class PKCEAuthFlow:
    def __init__(self):
        # IBM App ID specific configuration
        self.client_id = os.environ.get("IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID")
        self.client_secret = os.environ.get("IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET")
        self.tenant_id = os.environ.get("IBM_APPID_TENANT_ID", "us-south")
        self.base_url = f"https://{self.tenant_id}.appid.cloud.ibm.com/oauth/v4"
        
        # PKCE code verifier and challenge
        self.code_verifier = None
        self.code_challenge = None
        self.state = None
        
    def _generate_code_verifier(self) -> str:
        """Generate PKCE code verifier (43-128 chars)"""
        self.code_verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(96)[:128]
        return self.code_verifier
    
    def _generate_code_challenge(self, code_verifier: str) -> str:
        """Generate PKCE code challenge using S256 method"""
        sha256_hash = hashlib.sha256(code_verifier.encode()).digest()
        self.code_challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(sha256_hash).decode().replace("=", "")
        return self.code_challenge
    
    def _generate_state(self) -> str:
        """Generate state parameter for CSRF protection"""
        self.state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
        return self.state
    
    def get_authorization_url(self, redirect_uri: str, scope: str = "openid") -> str:
        """Generate authorization URL for user redirection"""
        self._generate_code_verifier()
        self._generate_code_challenge(self.code_verifier)
        self._generate_state()
        
        params = {
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "response_type": "code",
            "scope": scope,
            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
            "code_challenge": self.code_challenge,
            "code_challenge_method": "S256",
            "state": self.state
        }
        
        auth_url = f"{self.base_url}/{self.tenant_id}/authorization"
        return f"{auth_url}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
    
    def exchange_code_for_tokens(self, authorization_code: str, redirect_uri: str) -> Dict:
        """Exchange authorization code for tokens using PKCE"""
        if not self.code_verifier:
            raise ValueError("Code verifier not initialized. Call get_authorization_url first.")
        
        token_url = f"{self.base_url}/{self.tenant_id}/token"
        
        data = {
            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
            "client_id": self.client_id,
            "client_secret": self.client_secret,
            "code": authorization_code,
            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
            "code_verifier": self.code_verifier
        }
        
        headers = {
            "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
            "Accept": "application/json"
        }
        
        response = requests.post(token_url, data=data, headers=headers)
        response.raise_for_status()
        
        return response.json()
    
    def get_user_info(self, access_token: str) -> Dict:
        """Retrieve user information using access token"""
        userinfo_url = f"{self.base_url}/{self.tenant_id}/userinfo"
        
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
            "Accept": "application/json"
        }
        
        response = requests.get(userinfo_url, headers=headers)
        response.raise_for_status()
        
        return response.json()
    
    def validate_state(self, received_state: str) -> bool:
        """Validate state parameter to prevent CSRF attacks"""
        return secrets.compare_digest(self.state, received_state)
    
    def complete_flow(self, authorization_code: str, received_state: str, redirect_uri: str) -> Tuple[Dict, Dict]:
        """Complete the entire PKCE flow"""
        if not self.validate_state(received_state):
            raise ValueError("Invalid state parameter")
        
        tokens = self.exchange_code_for_tokens(authorization_code, redirect_uri)
        user_info = self.get_user_info(tokens["access_token"])
        
        return tokens, user_info
